title: Link a video to a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign as a creator
content_data:
Use this endpoint to link a video to a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign as a TikTok creator. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/creator/campaign/video/link/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
Use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Obtain%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) or [/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Renew%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) endpoint to get or renew an access token.| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |creator_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1768493902119937#item-link-Obtain%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) or [/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1768493902119937#item-link-Renew%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) to this field.| | tto_invite_link {Required} | string | An invite link that is associated with a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

To create a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign and obtain the associated invite link, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693549459458).

Note:

  • If the invite link is a campaign level invite link (the `campaign_type` of the associated campaign is `CAMPAIGN`), the creator should be one of the creators invited to the campaign. To confirm this, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693562720258) and check whether the returned `handle_names` includes the handle name of the creator (`creator_id`).
  • If the invite link is a brand level invite link (the `campaign_type` of the associated campaign is `BRAND`), the creator can be any TTO creator.
| | video_id{Required} | string | The ID of a video posted by the TTO creator.

To obtain a list of videos posted by a TTO creator, use [/tto/creator/authorized/video/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1834913554657282).
To publish a video post from the TikTok account of a TTO creator, use [/business/video/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228496095234).

Note: The ID cannot be of a video that has been linked to an existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/creator/campaign/video/link/' \ --header 'Access-Token: "{{Access-Token}}"' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "creator_id": "{{creator_id}}", "tto_invite_link": "{{tto_invite_link}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.

For a successful request, this field will be an empty object (`{}`).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
